answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before trading: the stake works like a jetty, where one boat docks cheaply but a fleet of fake identities must pay for every berth, so mass Sybils become ruinously expensive. Reputation then grows only from completed, paid work, and high-value deals require climbing to the summit of a trust ladder earned over months, never bought in bulk. A Sybil's pigment - its cheap copied identity - fades fast, since new accounts start at zero and cannot inherit another's standing. Attackers pay real money per identity and gain nothing transferable.
